text: Imagine making a video game
that earns more money in ONE DAY
than Avatar made during its entire cinema run.
Well, GTA 6 just did exactly that.
On November nineteenth, GTA 6 finally launched.
And Rockstar reported an absolutely ridiculous
THREE POINT SEVEN NINE BILLION DOLLARS
in first-day retail sales.
For comparison, Avatar made around
2.92 billion dollars at the worldwide box office.
But here's where things get even crazier.
Before GTA 6 was even released,
Rockstar says 32.5 MILLION COPIES
had already been sold.
GTA 5 took three days to reach one billion dollars.
GTA 6 smashed that in its first day.
And if you spread those reported sales
across 24 hours, that's an average of over
2.6 MILLION DOLLARS EVERY MINUTE.
That includes preorders, of course,
and movie ticket sales aren't directly comparable
to game retail sales.
But after thirteen years, GTA 6
didn't just break gaming records.
It became the biggest entertainment launch ever,
according to Rockstar.
So here's the real question...
how could GTA 7 possibly top THAT?
